about: J (wire) golden of pod-app's podd boundary: decoders (wire -> view model), status-stream notifications, control-connection requests and replies, the input connection, client-error classification and typed feature requests. 'expect' was captured once from the source before the split (84bdf9e) and is never regenerated from the code under test. Checked by crates/pod-app/src/source/wire_tests.rs.
changes: fx-app (2026-11-11), intended bug fix, edited by hand: a control/input result that does not decode fails only that request and keeps the connection. Cases: control 'poll repo.list with a bad shape keeps the connection', 'run bad result fails the request and keeps the connection', 'kill with a bad result fails the request and keeps the connection', 'task create bad result fails the request and keeps the connection'; input 'bad result keeps the connection' (a second send shows the kept connection). Everything else is the 84bdf9e capture.
